subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete sentence.
stimulus: There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. Air is an important i. fires to cook his food. b. Clean air is ii. element in our environment. c. Man makes iii. smoke pollute the air. d. The cooking iv. essential for life. e. All kinds of v. fire creates smoke. vi. air we become sick. vii. produce more smoke.
guide_solution: (a + ii) : Air is an important element in our environment. (b + iv) : Clean air is essential for life. (c + i) : Man makes fires to cook his food. (d + v) : The cooking fire creates smoke. (e + iii) : All kinds of smoke pollute the air.
